_comment: Resources shown in 'what to do now' cards, picked by ask x country. Compiled from memory on 2026-11-21: EVERY entry has verified=false until a person opens the link and confirms its purpose. 'countries': ISO codes or 'ALL'. 'asks': slot values from docs/scenario-engine.md.

resources.name: Have I Been Pwned
resources.purpose: Check whether your email appeared in a data breach.

resources.name: 2FA Directory
resources.purpose: See which services support two-factor login and how to turn it on.

resources.name: Bitwarden (free password manager)
resources.purpose: Unique passwords for every account.

resources.name: Take It Down (NCMEC)
resources.purpose: Remove intimate images taken when you were under 18.

resources.name: StopNCII.org
resources.purpose: Stop intimate images of adults being shared on partner platforms.

resources.name: urlscan.io
resources.purpose: Check what a suspicious link leads to without opening it yourself.

resources.name: VirusTotal
resources.purpose: Check a link or file against many security scanners at once.

resources.name: Google Safe Browsing site status
resources.purpose: Check whether a site is known to be dangerous.

resources.name: TinEye reverse image search
resources.purpose: Find out whether a profile photo is stolen.

resources.purpose: How to delete old accounts.

resources.name: Firefox Relay (email aliases)
